title: 217 East Twentieth: red brick and a copper corner oriel
items: 217 East Twentieth Street is rebuilt from the 1911 fire-insurance map and three photographs of the house that still stands: three storeys of red pressed brick over a sandstone base, a slate roof, and its rear wing.
Its signature corner oriel now stands at the street front's east end, sheathed in copper on a rounded copper underside, with two tiers of curved windows.
Under the oriel, the two round-headed windows the photographs show; the door sits on a short stoop beside them.
